arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Clement argued the mandate is essential to the rest of the Act.
Mr. Kneedler argued the minimum coverage provision is constitutional and severability is not needed.
Justice Sotomayor questioned the economic data on price increases.
Justice Scalia noted that severability tests vary across Court cases.
